responsibility: Defines the dep-graph module interface by re-exporting core types and declaring the `DepContext`, `Deps`, and `HasDepContext` traits plus fingerprint-style semantics that connect query execution to dependency tracking, forcing, and on-disk cache loading.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the dependency-tracking hub: it defines the `DepContext`/`Deps` boundary used to force dep nodes, inspect fingerprint styles, and load cached results, tying the query engine to the dep-graph rather than to hashing policy or generic query APIs.
